name: authors-forge
description: Author's Forge — durable, local-first AI publishing studio foundation.

scripts.build: rm -rf .forge-build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist && cp -R .forge-build dist && cp -R public dist/public
scripts.verify: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.js && npm run completion && npm run test:browser && npm run test:browser:mobile
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node scripts/studio-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-context-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-kdp-preflight-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-recovery-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-children-topics-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/guided-journal-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-publishing-promotion-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/studio-promotion-performance-browser-acceptance.js && node scripts/educational-workbook-browser-acceptance.js
